name: JSONL to Postgres canonical load
description: Use JSONL as a staging and interchange format, then load source records, normalized objects, entities, dedupe clusters, review tickets, promotion decisions, index records, partition manifests, and index deltas into Postgres as the canonical operational store.
operational_notes: Keep JSONL shards in object storage for replay and audit
Use upserts for idempotent worker reruns
Apply privacy and license gates before canonical load

name: pgvector object embedding store
description: Store embeddings for components, normalized objects, promotion decisions, source summaries, and entity descriptions in Postgres using pgvector so semantic search stays colocated with canonical metadata at small and medium scale.
operational_notes: Create HNSW index after bulk load in production

name: Index delta replay store
description: Persist partition manifests and append-only index deltas in Postgres so quality, facet, cost, keyword, freshness, and graph indexes can be replayed and audited without rebuilding all objects.
operational_notes: Store content hashes for tamper detection
Use replay reports before publishing index updates
